newsitem.title: UK: Manchester Utd marked up on bid report.
newsitem.headline: Manchester Utd marked up on bid report.

text.p: Shares in football club Manchester United Plc were marked higher in early trade on Tuesday following a report that video and publishing group VCI Plc made a bid to buy the club earlier this year.
Manchester United shares were marked seven pence higher at 453-1/2p by 0711 GMT.
The Financial Times newspaper reported that VCI offered around 480p per share for the football club.
The newspaper said VCI was forced to withdraw after a new television deal with BSkyB pushed Manchester United's share price sharply higher, putting the deal out of VCI's reach.
